acceptance_criteria.description: Saving a session_summary does not update, merge into, retitle, or retype a learning or debrief with the same session_ref.
Repeating a session_summary save for the same project and session_ref updates the existing session_summary idempotently without creating a duplicate.
The session-summary upsert lookup includes the memory type and project boundaries in addition to session_ref.
Regression tests cover the observed cross-type collision and verify all original non-summary records remain byte-for-byte unchanged in their primary content fields.
